form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.notes: Born-digital typed fillable form. Office field reads 'County Commission Seat A' (index.csv 'County Commission Seat A' - exact agreement). The ENTIRE address row (label bar included), the phone number and the signature block are redacted upstream by the county with wide black bars, so residence_city is ''; the email survives. FILER INCONSISTENCY, transcribed verbatim and NOT corrected: the form's formula makes Box F = Box A + Box B = 189.92, but the filer typed F = 0 (and a close of 0) - evidently reporting the net position after the equal-and-opposite expenditure. No arithmetic was applied. Boxes A, F and the close are typed '0' with no cents while B-E carry '$' and two decimals. Cover prints the filing address as 'disclosures@utahcounty.gov'.
